title: Anesthesiologist Assistants
description: Assist anesthesiologists in the administration of anesthesia for surgical and non-surgical procedures. Monitor patient status and provide patient care during surgical treatment.

tasks.text: Provide airway management interventions including tracheal intubation, fiber optics, or ventilary support.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — ALS requires hands-on airway, drugs, defibrillation

dwas.name: Implement advanced life support techniques.

tasks.text: Assist anesthesiologists in monitoring of patients, including electrocardiogram (EKG), direct arterial pressure, central venous pressure, arterial blood gas, hematocrit, or routine measurement of temperature, respiration, blood pressure or heart rate.
tasks.rationale: decision support — In-procedure patient monitoring is hands-on clinical work

dwas.name: Monitor patient conditions during treatments, procedures, or activities.
Assist healthcare practitioners during examinations or treatments.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on medical equipment adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust settings or positions of medical equipment.

tasks.text: Administer anesthetic, adjuvant, or accessory drugs under the direction of an anesthesiologist.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Anesthesia administration is high-risk hands-on clinical act

dwas.name: Administer anesthetics or sedatives to control pain.

tasks.text: Pretest and calibrate anesthesia delivery systems and monitors.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Hands-on examination of medical instruments

dwas.name: Examine medical instruments or equipment to ensure proper operation.
Maintain medical equipment or instruments.

tasks.text: Respond to emergency situations by providing cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR), basic cardiac life support (BLS), advanced cardiac life support (ACLS), or pediatric advanced life support (PALS).
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on emergency resuscitation and physical intervention

dwas.name: Treat medical emergencies.

tasks.text: Collect and document patients' pre-anesthetic health histories.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient history requires live elicitation and judgment

dwas.name: Gather medical information from patient histories.
Record patient medical histories.

tasks.text: Administer blood, blood products, or supportive fluids.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — IV fluid administration requires hands-on clinical skill

dwas.name: Administer blood or other fluids intravenously.

tasks.text: Verify availability of operating room supplies, medications, and gases.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Medical supply inventory records and thresholds automatable

dwas.name: Maintain inventory of medical supplies or equipment.

tasks.text: Assist anesthesiologists in performing anesthetic procedures, such as epidural or spinal injections.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on assistance during examinations

dwas.name: Administer anesthetics or sedatives to control pain.
Assist healthcare practitioners during examinations or treatments.

tasks.text: Assist in the provision of advanced life support techniques including those procedures using high frequency ventilation or intra-arterial cardiovascular assistance devices.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — ALS requires hands-on airway, drugs, defibrillation

dwas.name: Implement advanced life support techniques.

tasks.text: Monitor and document patients' progress during post-anesthesia period.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient history requires live elicitation and judgment

dwas.name: Monitor patient progress or responses to treatments.
Record patient medical histories.

tasks.text: Collect samples or specimens for diagnostic testing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Invasive specimen collection needs hands-on clinical skill

dwas.name: Collect biological specimens from patients.

tasks.text: Provide clinical instruction, supervision or training to staff in areas such as anesthesia practices.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Provider training is clinical, hands-on, accountable

dwas.name: Train medical providers.
Supervise patient care personnel.

tasks.text: Participate in seminars, workshops, or other professional activities to keep abreast of developments in anesthesiology.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI summarizes medical updates; human retains judgment

dwas.name: Maintain medical or professional knowledge.
